senses.sense_definition: A member of the Soviet political organization or a Communist bureaucrat.

examples.text: Every important planner and <w>apparatchik</w> in Russia was involved in the intense political debates of the time.
The ambitious Communist Party <w>apparatchik</w> used his influence to gain control over the regional government.

senses.sense_definition: A person who is a blindly loyal and unthinking bureaucrat.

examples.text: He was viewed as a dull <w>apparatchik</w> who was incapable of making independent decisions for the department.
The party leader surrounded himself with loyal <w>apparatchiks</w> who never questioned his controversial policies.
